title: Umugaragu wa Allah ukomeye
intro: Umva amagambo ahwihwisa y'umuntu wo mu bihe bya kera, umugaragu wa Allah wazamuwe mu mwanya urenze uw'abandi. Uyu muntu yari azwiho kwihangana gukomeye no kuba umunyakuri rwose, kandi yoherejwe ku bantu banze ubutumwa. Ni nde uyu muntu wo mu ijuru?
clues: Natowe na Allah nk'umuhanuzi kandi ndavugwa muri Korowani Ntagatifu.
Nari nziho kwihangana no kuba umunyakuri, imico Imana ishima.
Nahamagaye ubwoko bwanjye ngo busenge Imana imwe rukumbi, ariko benshi baranyanze.
Ahantu hawe hazamuwe n'Imana, kandi nahawe urwego rwo hejuru.
Nkunze kuvugwa hamwe n'abandi bahanuzi nka Ismail na Dhul-Kifl.
Allah aravuze kuri njye ati: 'Kandi twamuzamuye mu mwanya wo hejuru.' (19:57)
verse: And We raised him to a high station. (19:57)
